flows.name: Smoke test — app loads
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Assert 'Code Release Tracker' is visible. Assert 'File' is visible. Assert 'Version' is visible.

flows.name: Load sample data from File menu
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Assert 'Spring Ops Release' is visible. Assert 'Payments Patch Train' is visible.

flows.name: Create a new release
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Type 'Q3 Rollout' in the 'New release name' field. Type '2026-06-01' in the 'New release date' field. Click 'Create release'. Assert 'Q3 Rollout' is visible.

flows.name: Select a release and open the workspace
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Assert 'Repository ledger' is visible. Assert 'What ships inside this release' is visible. Assert 'gateway-service' is visible.

flows.name: Add a repository to a release
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Type 'audit-service' in the 'Repository name' field. Type '3.1.0' in the 'Repository version' field. Type 'candidate' in the 'Repository tag' field. Click 'Add repository'. Assert 'audit-service' is visible.

flows.name: Add a repository with an individual release date
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Type 'billing-worker' in the 'Repository name' field. Type '2.0.0' in the 'Repository version' field. Type '2026-03-10' in the 'Repository release date' field. Click 'Add repository'. Assert 'billing-worker' is visible.

flows.name: Filter the repository ledger
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Type 'gateway' in the 'Filter repositories' search field. Assert only 'gateway-service' is visible in the repository table and other repos are hidden. Clear the search field. Assert all repositories are visible again.

flows.name: Sort the repository ledger by version
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Click 'Version SORT'. Assert 'ASC' is visible. Click 'Version ASC'. Assert 'DESC' is visible.

flows.name: Sort the repository ledger by release date
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Click 'Release date SORT'. Assert 'ASC' is visible.

flows.name: Toggle between dark and light themes
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Assert 'Light' button is visible. Click the 'Light' button. Assert 'Dark' button is visible. Click the 'Dark' button. Assert 'Light' button is visible.

flows.name: Remove repository — cancel at confirmation dialog
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click 'Spring Ops Release'. Click 'Remove'. Assert 'gateway-service' is visible.

flows.name: Export tracker data
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Click the File button. Click 'Export tracker data'. Assert a file download is triggered or that the menu closes without an error.

flows.name: Clear tracker — cancel at confirmation dialog
flows.nlp: Navigate to http://localhost:5173. Click the 'File' button. Click 'Load sample data'. Assert releases are visible. Click the File button. Click 'Clear tracker'. Expect a confirmation dialog. Dismiss the dialog without confirming. Assert the releases are still visible in the list.
